projects.title: Directed Reading in Stochastic Calculus
projects.description: I gave a seminar on my independent study in Stochastic Calculus as a part of Emory's Math Directed Reading program. Advised by Mathematics PhD student Mitchell Scott.

projects.title: Traffic Collision Prediction using Graph Neural Networks
projects.description: Trained a spatio-temporal Graph Convolutional Network on 500k+ police records to predict collision hotspots in Los Angeles. Mined and integrated data from LAPD, LADOT, and Meteostat to create a dynamic graph representation of the city with street information, annual traffic volume, and weather features. ST-GCN model built using PyTorch Geometric and achieved an AUROC of over 80%.
